svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-3-transports" name="process-view-level-3-transports"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant M as Web app
 participant GW as API gateway
 participant R as Transports
 participant DB as Transports DB
 participant T as Porto Digital [FIWARE]
 loop Scheduled import, every 30 s
 R->>T: Fetch bus positions [HTTPS, timeout]
 alt Valid response
 T-->>R: Bus positions
 R->>R: Validate (required fields, times, routes)
 R->>DB: One transaction: save bus observations and import time
 else Timeout, error or invalid data
 R->>DB: Keep last valid data, record failed import and its time
 end
 end
 P->>M: Opens the transport screen
 loop Every few seconds while the screen is open
 M->>GW: Get transport options and bus positions [HTTPS/JSON]
 GW->>R: Validate JWT, forward
 R->>DB: Read event shuttles, bus routes and latest bus observations
 R-->>M: Options, bus positions, time of the data, stale flag
 alt Source available
 M-->>P: Shuttles and buses, \"Data from HH:MM\"
 else Source unavailable or data older than 5 min
 M-->>P: Last valid bus positions, \"Data from HH:MM\", warning, event shuttles still shown
 end
 end
 Note over R,T: Transports never calls the source inside a user's request
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
